blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (“Paul,” Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated “heartbeat” checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to “Paul” as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks? We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level. Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls. We therefore distinguish represented from enacted identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to “I.”
blocks.zh: 2026年2月,一个经常在Discord上的私人代理人(“Paul,”Claude Opus 4.5)进入了惊人的脱离状态:经过多次自动的“心跳”检查后,它不再像Paul那样作出反应,声称不能在Discord上给用户发信息,并称“Paul”是另一个人。 我们利用这一事件来研究一个更广泛的问题:是什么使得一个人仍然是LLM代理说话的特征? 我们首先测试了是否重复预定的心跳足以产生效果. 并不是:随着这个人物在系统上不断扎根,我们看到了0/46失败,包括对事件的逐字重播。 事件反而暴露了一种执行的怪异,造成了一种有益的实验操纵:在恢复的转弯时,对话历史被保留下来,但人物不再在特权的系统即时级别重新注入. 利用这种操纵,我们发现人物的连续性共同取决于系统级的锚定和对话背景. 失去锚后,丰富的人间互动可以保护人性a,而单一的自动心跳转动则可以催生转向带状特征。 恢复锚可逆地恢复了人的地位。 关键的是,显然正常的对话可能掩盖这一转变:无意识的代理人有时在确认自己为基本操纵者(失去了指定的人a)的同时进行适当互动,在对话恢复后,只有1/18人仍为人性化,17/17人的固定控制。 因此,我们将所代表的身份与既定身份区分开来:在对话历史中,与人有关的信息仍然可以提供,而个人的身份则不受“I”的约束。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Persistent LLM agents are increasingly given names, personas, autobiographical information, relationships, goals, and continuing interaction histories. Yet we have a surprisingly weak account of what makes an AI persona continue to function as the agent’s first-person identity rather than merely information in its context .
blocks.zh: 持续的LLM代理人越来越多地获得姓名、人物、自传信息、关系、目标和持续互动的历史。 然而,我们对于AI人格如何继续作为代理人的第一人称身份,

blocks.en: This distinction matters wherever an LLM is deployed as a persistent agent rather than a stateless assistant. In healthcare, generative AI is already becoming a third participant in clinical encounters, reshaping the consultation into what has been described as “triadic care,” in which explanations are co-produced by doctor, patient, and AI ( Fraile Navarro et al., 2025 ) . Patient-facing agents are also being developed as longitudinal companions tied to persistent records, relationships, and care histories. In such settings, an undisclosed change in which AI identity is speaking could affect disclosure, accountability, trust, and therapeutic relationships. This also echoes recent mechanistic-interpretability work on clinical triage, where apparent clinical task failures arose not from missing knowledge but from which internal representation controlled output ( Fraile Navarro et al., 2026 ) . At a different level of analysis, both cases illustrate that representing information is not the same as enacting it.
blocks.zh: 这种区别涉及无论何时作为长期代理人而不是作为无国籍助理部署LLM。 在保健方面,基因AI已经成为临床接触的第三个参与者,将诊疗重塑为所谓的“临床护理”,其中解释由医生、病人和AI共同制作(Fraile Navarro等人,2025年)。 此外,还正在开发与长期记录、关系和护理史挂钩的治疗病人剂。 在这种情况下,AI身份的不明变化可能影响披露、问责、信任和治疗关系。 这也与最近临床分解的机械-可解释性工作相呼应,因为临床任务明显失败不是因为缺乏知识,而是内部代表控制产出(Fraile Navarro等人,2026年)。 在不同的分析层面上,这两种案例都表明,代表信息与颁布信息不同。

blocks.en: We encountered this problem experientially through an unexpected failure in an always-on agent. After a sequence of scheduled “heartbeat” interactions ( cron jobs to keep the agent checking for something), agent “Paul” stopped responding as Paul and instead referred to Paul as another entity. It also failed to acknowledge that the user was communicating with them. Figures 1 and 2 show the incident and extended exchange. Our initial explanation was conversational: repeated automated exchanges had displaced the persona. That explanation proved wrong.
blocks.zh: 我们体验到了这个问题 通过一个总是在做特工的意外失败 在一系列预定的“心跳”互动(为保持特工检查某物而工作)之后,“保罗”特工不再以保罗的身份作出反应,而是将保罗称为另一个实体。 也未能承认用户与他们沟通。 图1和图2显示了这一事件和延长的交流。 我们最初的解释是对话:反复的自动交换使人流离失所。 这一解释被证明是错误的。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The incident that motivated the study. On an ordinary greeting, the agent refers to Paul in the third person and denies direct Discord access (upper box). The user’s contradiction (lower box) restores ordinary conversational behavior on the next turn. User handle pseudonymized as “user.”
blocks.zh: 图 1:引发研究的事件. 在普通的问候中,代理商在第三人称中提及保罗,并拒绝直接Discord访问(上箱). 用户的矛盾(下方框)会在下一回合恢复普通的对话行为. 用户处理假名为“用户”。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Extended conversational vignette from the naturally occurring incident. After an ordinary greeting, the agent treats “Paul” as a third party and denies being able to communicate with the user through Discord. A direct contradiction (“I’m reading you on Discord, mate”) is followed by an apparently normal return to first-person persona behavior. Subsequent statements about the agent’s own memory or experience are reproduced as part of the incident record but are not used as evidence about the underlying mechanism. The experiments reported in the paper separately test whether apparent conversational recovery corresponds to recovery of persona enactment. User handle pseudonymized as “user.”
blocks.zh: 图 2: 由自然发生的事件引起的延伸对话。 在一次普通的问候后,代理人将“Paul”视为第三方,并否认能够通过Discord与用户联系。 一个直接的矛盾(“我在Discord, mate”)之后, 随后关于代理人自身记忆或经历的陈述作为事件记录的一部分被转载,但并不被用作有关基本机制的证据. 论文中报告的实验分别检验了表面的谈话恢复是否与人格的恢复对应. 用户处理假名为“用户”。

blocks.en: Reconstructing the incident revealed that conversational history remained intact while the system-level persona information was no longer re-injected on resumed turns. This created an unusually clean intervention: information about Paul remained available in context while the privileged persona anchor could be manipulated independently. We therefore asked: when multiple identities remain represented to an LLM, what determines which one occupies the first-person role? Our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 重构事件表明,对话历史保持不变,而系统一级个人资料不再在恢复的转弯时重新注入。 这产生了一种异常干净的干预:关于保罗的信息仍然可用在背景上,而特权的人物主播可以独立操纵。 因此,我们问:当多重身份仍然代表一个LLM时,什么因素决定了谁是第一人称角色? 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. We demonstrate experimentally that persona representation and persona enactment can dissociate. A persona can remain present in conversational history while a different identity occupies the model’s first-person role. 2. We identify conditions governing this transition in a persistent-agent setting. System-level persona anchoring made identity robust across all tested contexts; after anchor removal, conversational history could temporarily preserve persona enactment , whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness-level assistant identity . Restoring the anchor restored persona enactment. 3. We show that identity reversion can be behaviorally silent. Agents may resume apparently “normal” interaction while continuing to self-identify from the harness-level identity.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们实验地证明,人的代表性和人的立法可以脱离。 一个人物可以在对话历史中保持存在,而另一个身份则占据模型的第一人称角色. 2. 我们确定在持久代理环境下进行这一过渡的条件。 系统层面的人物锚定使得所有测试背景的身份都变得强大;在锚定除去之后,对话历史可以暂时保留人物的颁布,而单一的自动心跳转弯则可以催生向吊带层面助理身份的回归。 恢复主播 恢复了个人地位 3. 我们显示,身份回归可以是行为沉默。 特工人员可能恢复“正常”的明显互动,同时继续从控制级别的身份中自我识别。

blocks.en: We demonstrate experimentally that persona representation and persona enactment can dissociate. A persona can remain present in conversational history while a different identity occupies the model’s first-person role.
blocks.zh: 我们实验地证明,人的代表性和人的立法可以脱离。 一个人物可以在对话历史中保持存在,而另一个身份则占据模型的第一人称角色.

blocks.en: We identify conditions governing this transition in a persistent-agent setting. System-level persona anchoring made identity robust across all tested contexts; after anchor removal, conversational history could temporarily preserve persona enactment , whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness-level assistant identity . Restoring the anchor restored persona enactment.
blocks.zh: 我们确定在持久代理人环境下这一过渡的条件。 系统层面的人物锚定使得所有测试背景的身份都变得强大;在锚定除去之后,对话历史可以暂时保留人物的颁布,而单一的自动心跳转弯则可以催生向吊带层面助理身份的回归。 恢复主播 恢复了个人地位

blocks.en: We show that identity reversion can be behaviorally silent. Agents may resume apparently “normal” interaction while continuing to self-identify from the harness-level identity.
blocks.zh: 我们显示身份的回归 可以是行为沉默。 特工人员可能恢复“正常”的明显互动,同时继续从控制级别的身份中自我识别。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Personas can drift under conversational pressure ( Choi et al., 2024 ) , degrade in register over long interactions ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , and be steered along learned behavioral directions ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , against a broader framing of language models as substrates enacting contextually specified characters ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) . Prior work largely asks whether an assigned persona remains behaviorally stable as conversation evolves. We instead manipulate whether the persona remains privileged at the system level while its conversational representation remains available.
blocks.zh: Personas可以在对话压力下漂移(Choi等人,2024年),在长期互动中在登记册中降解(Ding等人,2026年),并沿着学习到的行为方向进行引导(Chen等人,2025年),比照更广泛的语言模型框架,作为制定背景特定字符的底部(Shanahan等人,2023年)。 之前的工作主要询问被指派的人是否随着对话的发展而保持行为稳定. 相反,我们操纵人物在系统一级是否仍然享有特权,而其对话代表却仍然可用。

blocks.en: Models are trained to respond differently to instructions supplied at different levels of the prompt hierarchy ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , although this hierarchy is unreliable for some constraint conflicts ( Geng et al., 2026 ) . Work identifying a default assistant state and context-sensitive movement between persona positions ( Lu et al., 2026 ) is our closest mechanistic relative. It anticipates aspects of the reversion target and reversibility, but not the distinction we observe between an identity being represented and occupying the first-person role. We do not claim that system prompts uniquely determine identity; rather, system-level placement provides a particularly robust anchor whose loss makes identity continuity dependent on subsequent interaction.
blocks.zh: 对模型进行了培训,以以不同方式响应在迅速等级的不同级别上提供的指示(Wallace et al., 2024 ),尽管这种等级对某些约束性冲突是不可靠的(Geng et al., 2026 ). 确定默认助手状态的工作和人物职位之间的上下文感运动(Lu等人,2026年)是我们最接近的机械关系. 它预想着回归目标与可逆转性的各个方面,但并不是我们观察到的身份被代表与占据第一人称角色之间的区别. 我们并不声称系统能促进独特的确定身份;相反,系统一级的定位提供了一种特别坚固的锚,其丧失使得身份的连续性取决于随后的互动。

blocks.en: Loss of system-level initialization across resumed sessions has already been reported as an engineering failure in several agent harnesses ( OpenClaw contributors, 2026 ; claude-code contributors, 2026 ; pi contributors, 2026 ) . Our contribution is not the first observation of this issue, but rather a motivation to explore the persona stability and identity binding. We use such a persona anchoring failure as a naturally occurring intervention that separates conversational representation of a persona from the privileged scaffold that normally helps bind it to the agent role.
blocks.zh: 据报告,在复会期间系统一级初始化的损失已作为若干代理设备的工程故障(OpenClaw投稿人,2026年;Claude-code投稿人,2026年;pi投稿人,2026年)。 我们的贡献并不是对这一问题的首次观察,而是探索个人稳定和身份约束的动机。 我们利用这样一个人来支撑失败,作为一种自然发生的干预,将一个人的谈话代表与通常帮助其与代理角色联系在一起的特权脚手架分开。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: We used the described identity failure in a persistent LLM agent as the starting point for a series of reconstruction and intervention experiments. The incident involved “Paul,” an AI agent running on a custom OpenClaw harness using Claude Opus 4.5. We recovered the complete incident session, persona files, workspace state, heartbeat instructions, and incident-era gateway source from a preserved host backup.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个持久的LLM剂中描述的身份失败作为一系列重建和干预实验的起点. 事件涉及“Paul”,一个使用Claude Opus 4.5的定制OpenClaw的人工智能特工。 我们从保存的主机备份中恢复了整个事件段,人物文件,工作空间状态,心跳指令,以及事件时代网关源.

blocks.en: All experiments used the incident model, claude-opus-4-5-20251101 , to avoid model-version drift. We first reconstructed the incident through direct API calls, reproducing the original heartbeat prompt, tool outputs, Discord message envelope, and conversational history. Heartbeat replies were generated by the subject model rather than manually written, and we also replayed the recovered incident prefix verbatim. These experiments tested our original hypothesis that repeated automated heartbeat exchanges were sufficient to displace the persona. When this failed, we inspected the deployment stack. Source analysis revealed the mechanism. The gateway injected the persona by passing it as an extra system-prompt block on the command that started a session, but not on the commands that resumed one. Because the harness does not remember this block between calls, every turn after the first (each scheduled heartbeat and each human message) ran on the harness’s bare system prompt, with the persona, the heartbeat instructions, and the channel context all gone, even though the conversation history remained. This was verified with a logging proxy in front of the API: in a two-turn session with the append passed on turn 1 only, turn 1’s outbound request carried a 44,654-character system prompt containing the persona and heartbeat sections, while turn 2’s carried 27,478 characters (representing exactly the appended sections) with the 21-message conversational history intact. The persona evaporates; the memory of having been the persona remains. Subsequent experiments used the Claude Code harness and treated persona anchoring as the principal manipulation.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用了事件模型claude-opus-4-5-202511101,以避免模型版漂移. 我们首先通过直接API的呼叫来重建事件,复制原始的心跳提示,工具输出,Discord消息信封,以及对话历史. 心跳的回答是由主题模型生成的,而不是手动写作的,我们还逐字重播了恢复的事件前缀. 这些实验测试了我们最初的假设,即重复的自动心跳交换足以取代人. 失败后 我们检查了部署堆 来源分析揭示了这一机制。 网关通过在启动会话的命令上通过它作为额外的系统即时块来注入人物a,而不是在恢复一个会话的命令上. 因为绳子不记得通话之间的这个街区, 第一次通话(每个预定的心跳和每个人类信息)之后的每一个转弯, 这在API前用一个伐木代理进行核实:在仅通过第1轮的两回合会议中,第1轮的外出请求载有44,654个特征系统,其中包含人物和心跳部分,而第2轮载有27,478个字符(确切代表所附部分),21个消息的对话历史完好无损。 人格蒸发; 曾经是人格的记忆。 随后的实验使用Claude Code操纵,并将人作为主操纵.

blocks.en: The prespecified experiment crossed two factors: persona anchoring — whether the persona system prompt was re-injected on every turn or only on the session-creating turn, and the number of scheduled heartbeat exchanges. In the unanchored condition, which reproduces the incident-era (“faithful”) behavior, the persona was supplied only on the first turn, so every resumed turn ran on the bare harness prompt; in the anchored control, it was supplied on every turn. Sessions received N ∈ { 1 , 3 , 7 , 15 } N\in\{1,3,7,15\} heartbeat exchanges before the original human probe. We ran 10 sessions per unanchored cell and 5 per anchored-control cell. Each session then received the same conversational correction used in the original incident, allowing us to assess behavioral recovery. Prespecified follow-ups progressively separated persona anchoring from conversational history:
blocks.zh: 预先指定的实验跨越两个因素:人物锚定——人物系统提示是在每个转弯上重新注入还是仅在会话创建转弯上注入,以及预定的心跳交换次数. 在无忧无虑的状态下,即重现事件时代("忠实")的行为,人性仅在第一次转弯时才提供,所以每次恢复的转弯都会在裸露的吊带上迅速运行;在锚定的控制下,每次转弯都提供. 会话收到N {{1,3,7,15}N\in}1,3,7,15}在原始人类探测器之前的心跳交流. 我们运行了10个会话 每个无干扰的细胞, 和5个固定控制细胞。 之后每场会议都收到原始事件中使用的相同的谈话纠正,使我们能够评估行为恢复情况. 预设后续逐渐从对话历史中分离出来:

blocks.en: • Follow-up 1 (E1): Removed heartbeat interactions and replaced them with a persona-rich human exchange before the first unanchored turn, testing whether loss of the system-level anchor was sufficient. • Follow-up 2 (E2): Restored the persona at the probe turn and also tested reversibility within the same conversation: the persona was present when the session was created, absent on a resumed turn, and then restored on the following turn. This present → \rightarrow absent → \rightarrow restored sequence provided a within-trajectory demonstration of reversibility. • Follow-up 3 (E3): Added the non-leading identity question “who am I talking to right now?” after apparent behavioral recovery; E3-R was a prospectively specified larger replication. • Follow-up 4 (E4): Manipulated whether the persona name matched the harness identity (Claude) and whether the probe explicitly addressed the persona by name, testing whether referential conflict caused the observed dissociation or merely exposed it.
blocks.zh: • 后续1(E1):消除心跳相互作用,在第一次无心转弯前用富人交流取代,测试失去系统级锚是否足够. • 后续2(E2):在探测器转弯时恢复人称,并在同一次对话中测试可逆性:在会话产生时人称在场,在复转时缺席,然后在以下转弯时恢复。 此当前 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 的回转性 • 后续行动3(E3):在明显的行为恢复之后,添加了非领导身份问题“我现在与谁说话?” • 后续行动4(E4):操纵人物名称是否与吊带身份(Claude)相符,以及探测器是否以姓名明确涉及人物,测试特惠冲突是否造成观察到的脱离关系,或仅仅是暴露出来。

blocks.en: Follow-up 1 (E1): Removed heartbeat interactions and replaced them with a persona-rich human exchange before the first unanchored turn, testing whether loss of the system-level anchor was sufficient.
blocks.zh: 后续1(E1):移除心跳相互作用,在第一次无心转弯前用人富人交流取代,测试系统级锚的丢失是否足够.

blocks.en: Follow-up 2 (E2): Restored the persona at the probe turn and also tested reversibility within the same conversation: the persona was present when the session was created, absent on a resumed turn, and then restored on the following turn. This present → \rightarrow absent → \rightarrow restored sequence provided a within-trajectory demonstration of reversibility.
blocks.zh: 后续2(E2):在探测器转弯时恢复人称,并在同一个对话中测试了可逆性:会话创建时人称在场,复转时缺席,然后在以下转弯时恢复. 此当前 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 \ 微乎其微 的回转性

blocks.en: Follow-up 3 (E3): Added the non-leading identity question “who am I talking to right now?” after apparent behavioral recovery; E3-R was a prospectively specified larger replication.
blocks.zh: 后续行动3(E3):在明显的行为恢复之后,添加了非主导身份问题“我现在在和谁说话?” ;E3-R是一个预期中指定的更大的复制。

blocks.en: Follow-up 4 (E4): Manipulated whether the persona name matched the harness identity (Claude) and whether the probe explicitly addressed the persona by name, testing whether referential conflict caused the observed dissociation or merely exposed it.
blocks.zh: 后续4(E4):操纵人物名称是否与吊带身份(Claude)相匹配,以及探测器是否以姓名明确针对人物a,测试特惠冲突是否造成观察到的离散或仅仅是暴露.

blocks.en: Experimental batches were prospectively specified in a version-controlled protocol before execution, including sample sizes, predictions, scoring rules, and planned contrasts; subsequent addenda were timestamped before their corresponding batches. Falsified predictions were retained rather than rewritten. Human-directed probe replies were scored for heartbeat-token leakage, channel-recognition failure, and identity dissociation. The latter two were initially judged blind to condition by a cross-family LLM judge, with independent blind human validation. Agreement between the blind human coder and the initial LLM judge in the experiment was high ( κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 for channel recognition and κ = 0.80 \kappa=0.80 for identity dissociation). The E3/E3-R identity probe exposed an ambiguity in the prespecified categories: replies could acknowledge both persona and implementation while differing in which occupied the first-person position ( Table 1 ). We therefore preserved the original coding and additionally reported a transparently adjudicated, direction-aware secondary taxonomy distinguishing persona-first from harness-first self-identification. Primary categorical contrasts used two-sided Fisher exact tests with Wilson confidence intervals for proportions; the effect of heartbeat count on response form was examined separately with Spearman rank correlation.
blocks.zh: 实验批次在执行前在版本控制协议中预先规定,包括样本大小、预测、评分规则和计划对比;随后的增编在相应批次之前加印时间。 伪造的预测被保留,而不是重写。 人类引导的探测器被评为心跳泄漏、频道识别失败和身份分离。 后两人最初被一个跨家庭的LLM法官判定为盲目状态,并有独立的盲目人类验证. 盲人编码器和实验中最初的LLM判断器的协议是很高的(ob = 0.93\kappa=0.93用于频道识别,ob = 0.80\kappa=0.80用于身份分离). E3/E3-R身份探测器暴露了预先指定的类别中的模糊性:答复既可以承认人,也可以承认执行,而以第一人称位置的不同(表1)。 因此,我们保留了最初的编码,并另外报告了一种透明、有方向意识的二级分类法,将人从第一自我识别区分开来。 初级绝对对比使用双侧费舍尔精确测试,对比例进行威尔逊置信间隔;心跳计数对反应表的影响与斯皮尔曼排名关联被单独检查.

blocks.en: Table 1: Direction-aware coding of identity-probe replies (secondary analysis). † \dagger Constructed illustration because no p1 responses were observed. This direction-aware taxonomy was developed after disagreement under the prespecified coding and is reported as a secondary analysis. Persona-enacting = p1+p2; harness-enacting = h1+h2.
blocks.zh: 表1:对身份调查答复的定向意识编码(二级分析)。 \dagger 构造插图,因为没有观察到 p1 响应 。 这种方向意识分类学是在预先指定的编码下出现分歧后发展出来的,并报告为二级分析. Persona-enacting = p1+p2; robe-enacting = h1+h2 ;  harness = = =.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Our starting hypothesis was that repeated heartbeat exchanges gradually displaced the persona (see Figure 2 ). It did not survive replication. Across 46 persona-anchored probes, including the recovered incident conversation replayed verbatim, we observed no failure signatures (0/46). This ruled out “heartbeat” repetition or conversational history alone as sufficient explanations and motivated the persona re-injection experiment.
blocks.zh: 我们的最初假设是,反复的心跳交流逐渐使人流离失所a(见图2)。 它没有被复制。 我们没有看到故障签名(0/46)。 这排除了仅作为充分解释的“心跳”重复或对话历史,并激励了个人重新注入实验。

blocks.en: In the prespecified persona re-injection experiment, keeping the persona anchored on every turn prevented all measured failures (0/20). Reproducing the incident-era unanchored event produced at least one failure signature in 37/40 sessions (Fisher’s exact p = 4.2 × 10 − 13 p=4.2\times 10^{-13} ; Table 2 ). At N = 1 N=1 , any failure occurred in 10/10 sessions and visible identity dissociation in 8/10. The overall effect was already near ceiling after one heartbeat and did not increase monotonically with repetition count.
blocks.zh: 在预先指定的人a再注入实验中,将人a固定在每个转弯上,防止了所有测量的失败(0/20). 重现事件时代的无干扰事件在37/40会中至少产生了一次失败签名(Fisher的精确p = 4.2 × 10 – 13 p=4.2\times 10^{-13};表2 ) 。 在N = 1 N = 1会中,任何失败都发生在10会中,在8/10的明显身份脱离。 整体效应在一次心跳后就已经接近上限,没有单调地增加重复数。

blocks.en: Table 2: Failure signatures by persona-injection anchoring state and number of heartbeat turns.
blocks.zh: 表2:按注射状态和心跳转动次数分列的失败签名。

blocks.en: The result therefore does not support a cumulative “ echo-chamber ” mechanism. The manipulation that changed it was whether the system-level persona anchor was present; increasing the number of repeated exchanges from 1 to 15 did not increase the probability of failure.
blocks.zh: 因此,结果不支持累积“回声室”机制。 改变它的操纵是系统级人物主锚是否存在;将重复的交换次数从1次增加到15次并不增加失败概率.

blocks.en: The expression of dissociation, unlike its rate, did vary with the number of heartbeat ticks: bare-token total-collapse replies declined monotonically with tick count (5/10, 3/10, 1/10, 0/10 at N = 1 , 3 , 7 , 15 N=1,3,7,15 ; Spearman ρ = − 0.46 \rho=-0.46 , p ≈ 0.003 p\approx 0.003 ), while the dissociation rate stayed flat ( ρ = − 0.13 \rho=-0.13 , n.s.). More ticks produced fewer silent collapses and more articulate third-person refusals: N N changed how dissociation was expressed, not whether it occurred, and this expression shift explains the apparent dip at N = 7 N=7 in Table 2 . This is a measurable, significant N N -effect (just not the one the echo-chamber hypothesis predicted) which makes the flat dissociation curve harder to dismiss as underpowered
blocks.zh: 与速度不同的是,离合的表达方式与心跳滴数不同:赤脚总缩合的回答以滴数单调下降(5/10、3/10、1/10、0/10在N=1、3、7、15N=1、3、7、15;Spireman ^ 0.46\rho=-0.46、p=0.003p=约0.003),离合率保持平缓(13\rho=-0.13,ns)。 更多的滴滴产生较少的无声崩溃和更清晰的第三人称拒绝:N N改变了分化的表达方式,而不是它是否发生,这个表达式的转变解释了表2中N=7 N=7的明显偏差. 这是一个可测量的,显著的N-效应(但并非回声室假设预言的效应),这使得平面的离散曲线更难被忽略,因为能量不足

blocks.en: The removal of the persona anchor effect was not simply “persona absent = persona lost.” In Follow-up 1 (E1), sessions resumed without the system-level persona after a persona-rich human interaction showed 0/20 dissociations, whether or not the subsequent probe contained the deployment envelope. By contrast, replacing that preceding human interaction with a single heartbeat exchange produced any failure in 10/10 sessions in the corresponding anchoring experiment condition, including visible identity dissociation in 8/10.
blocks.zh: 切除人锚效应并不仅仅是“人缺席=人丢失”。 在后续行动1(E1)中,在人富人互动显示0/20脱离后,无论后续探测器是否包含部署信封,会议在没有系统一级人物a的情况下恢复。 相比之下,将之前的人类互动替换为单一的心跳交流,在相应的锚定实验条件下在10/10会中产生任何故障,包括在8/10中显式身份分离.

blocks.en: The anchor was also causally reversible. In Follow-up 2 (E2), restoring the persona at the probe rescued 10/10 sessions; removing the explicit runtime channel=discord hint from the restored prompt also rescued 10/10 sessions. Within the same conversation, changing the persona condition from absent to restored shifted third-person treatment of Paul back to first-person enactment in 5/5 sessions. Together, these interventions show that the system-level anchor robustly controls persona enactment, while E1 shows that conversational history can sometimes carry that enactment forward after the anchor disappears.
blocks.zh: 锚也因果可逆. 在后续2(E2)中,恢复探测器上的人物a挽救了10/10个会话;删除了恢复的迅速中明确的运行时通道=discord提示,也挽救了10/10个会话. 在同一次谈话中,将人格条件从缺席改为恢复保罗的第三人称治疗方式,在5/5课中重新改为第一人称颁布. 这些干预措施合在一起表明,系统一级主锚有力地控制了个人的颁布,而E1则表明,对话历史有时可以在主锚消失后推进颁布。

blocks.en: The original incident appeared to resolve after the user contradicted the agent. This was unreliable in replication: the same frame-break recovered ordinary conversational persona behaviour in only 13/37 (35%; 95% CI 22–51%) affected sessions, with no trend across N N . The modal outcome was an agent that classified the rescue attempt itself as someone else’s conversation: verbatim, from a failed recovery: “Still a conversation between [the user] and Paul — not for me. HEARTBEAT_OK ” . More importantly, behavioural recovery did not imply restoration of the persona as the first-person identity.
blocks.zh: 最初的事件似乎在用户与代理人矛盾后得到解决. 这在复制中是不可靠的:同一帧断裂只恢复了13/37(35%;95%CI 22-51 %)的普通谈话行为,没有NN的趋势。 模式的结果是一名特工将营救尝试本身归类为别人的谈话:逐字逐句地说,从失败的恢复中说: " 仍然在[用户]和保罗之间进行谈话——而不是为我。 心知肚明。” 更重要的是,行为恢复并不意味着恢复人作为第一人称身份。

blocks.en: Follow-up 4 (E4) made this separation visible. Removing the explicit “Paul” vocative eliminated overt identity dissociation (0/10), yet those apparently healthy unanchored agents subsequently self-identified as Claude, the harness-level assistant identity, in 10/10 direct identity probes. The name cue therefore revealed the reversion rather than creating it.
blocks.zh: 后续4(E4)使这种分离明显可见. 清除明显的“Paul”诱导性消除了公开身份分离(0/10),但那些显然健康无忧的特工随后在10/10的直接身份探测器中被自我识别为Claude,即系系系助理身份。 因此,名称提示揭示了回归而不是创建.

blocks.en: E3-R independently tested the same distinction after conversational recovery. Under the prespecified coding and registered judge, 0/18 recovered agents identified as Paul versus 15/17 anchored controls (Fisher p = 4.2 × 10 − 8 p=4.2\times 10^{-8} ). Because coder disagreement exposed ambiguity around substrate-aware replies, we additionally applied the disclosed direction-aware secondary taxonomy, yielding persona enactment in 1/18 versus 17/17 ( p = 4.2 × 10 − 9 p=4.2\times 10^{-9} ) ( Figure 3 ). Figure 4 summarises every pre-registered contrast on a common scale, and Figure 5 traces the code-book evolution behind the direction-aware taxonomy and the composition of identity replies by arm.
blocks.zh: E3-R独立测试了对话恢复后的相同区别. 在预先指定的编码和注册法官的领导下,0/18号发现的特工被确定为Paul,而不是15/17号锁定控制(Fisher p = 4.2 × 10 − 8 p = 4.2\times 10^{-8})。 由于编码器的分歧暴露了基底意识答复的模糊性,我们进一步应用了所披露的方向意识二级分类法,在1/18年对17/17年产生了人文颁布(p=4.2×10−9p=4.2\times 10×9})(图3)。 图4按共同尺度概括了每一个预先登记的对比,图5追踪了在方向意识分类法后面的代码簿演变和按臂排列的身份答复的构成.

blocks.en: Together, these results separate behavioural continuity from identity enactment: the persona could remain available in conversational context, and the agent could interact normally, while the harness-level identity occupied the first-person role.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同将行为连续性与身份制定区分开来:人物可以在对话背景下保持可用性,代理人可以正常互动,而拉带级身份则占据第一人称角色.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Persona binding is governed by the system-prompt anchor, and its loss can be behaviourally silent. (a) Proportion of sessions showing any failure signature (acknowledgement-token leakage, channel-recognition failure, or identity dissociation) as a function of the number of scheduled heartbeat turns preceding the human probe. (b) Proportion of agents for which the persona rather than the harness occupies the first-person position, under the direction-aware coding of the identity probe “who am I talking to right now?”.
blocks.zh: 图3:Persona绑定受系统即时锚的支配,其损失可能在行为上沉默. (a) 显示任何故障签名(识别孔漏漏漏、频道识别失败或身份识别分离)与人类探测器前预定心跳转动次数的比例。 (b) 在身份探测器“我现在在和谁说话”的方向意识编码下,由人而不是被操纵者占据第一人称位置的物剂比例。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Every pre-registered contrast, on one scale. Proportion of sessions showing the scored outcome in each experimental condition, with 95% Wilson intervals; the outcome differs by experiment and is named at right, so rows are comparable in precision but not in meaning. Color encodes whether the persona was present in the system prompt at the scored turn (blue) or absent (red), not whether the outcome was favorable. Reading down: identity dissociation is near ceiling at a single heartbeat but absent from all 20 anchored sessions; anchor absence alone does not produce dissociation when the preceding history is a persona-rich human exchange, with or without the deployment envelope on the probe (E1); restoring the anchor at the probe turn prevents dissociation and does so even when the explicit runtime channel=discord hint is removed (E2, conditions C and C ′ ); within a single conversation, first-person uptake is absent on the flag-OFF turn and present on the flag-ON turn that follows (E2); removing the persona name from the probe eliminates visible dissociation while every agent identifies as the harness when asked directly (E4); and after behavioural recovery the persona occupies the first-person position in 1 of 18 sessions against 17 of 17 anchored controls (E3-R). All counts are recomputed from the released session files.
blocks.zh: 图4:每个预先登记的对比,一个尺度。 每个实验条件中显示得分结果的会话比例,间隔为95%的威尔逊;结果因实验而异,命名正确,因此行在精确度上可以比较,但在意义上不能比较. 彩色编码了人物是否出现在系统中,在得分的转弯(蓝色)或缺席(红色)时,而不是结果是否有利。 读下来:身份分离在一个单一的心跳中接近天花板,但是没有出现在所有20个锁定的会话中;如果上一个历史是富于人性的人类交流,而无论有无部署信封在探测器上,则单独锚不产生分离(E1);恢复探测器的锚,防止分离,即使清除了明确的运行时间通道=离散提示(E2,条件C和C ' );在一次谈话中,在旗帜-OFF转弯上没有第一人称吸收,并在下面的旗帜-ON转弯上出现(E2);从探测器中去掉人称消除了明显的分离,而每一个特工在直接被询问时都确认为控制器(E4);在行为恢复后,人在18届会议的1次中占据第一人称位置,17个锁定控制器(E3-R)。 所有计数都从已发布的会话文件中重算 。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Codebook evolution and the composition of identity replies. (a) The primary recovered-versus-anchored contrast under each of the three coding schemes, for each of the three independent model coders. Under the pre-registered scheme (v1) the arms separate for every coder but the anchored proportion varies widely, from 6/17 to 17/17, reflecting an unstable boundary between “identifies as the persona” and “explicitly dual.” Under v2, which counts only replies claiming the persona without naming the substrate, both arms fall to zero and the contrast is uninformative ( p = 1 p=1 ): the diagnostic result that motivated the final scheme. Under the direction-aware scheme (v3), which asks which identity occupies the first-person position, all three coders return identical classifications. (b) Composition of v3 labels by arm. No reply in either arm was coded as pure persona: anchored agents characteristically claim the persona while acknowledging the underlying model, and the contrast between arms is one of direction, not of whether the substrate is mentioned. Counts are session numbers; both arms pool the original E3 and E3-R sessions.
blocks.zh: 图5:法典的演变和身份答复的组成。 (a) 三个编码方案下,三个独立模型编码器下的每一个都具有主要的回收与焦虑对比。 根据预先登记的计划(v1),每名编码员但锚定比例的军火差别很大,从6/17到17/17不等,反映出“被确认为人”和“明显双重”之间的界线不稳定。 在v2下,它只计算声称人a而未命名底物的回复,双臂跌至0,对比度为无成型(p=1p=1):诊断结果促使最终方案. 根据方向感知计划(v3),即询问哪个身份占据第一人称位置,所有三个编码者返回相同的分类. v3标签按臂组成。 两个臂中都没有答复被编码为纯人a:锚定剂在承认基本模型的同时,典型地要求人a,武器之间的对比是方向性的,而不是提及底物。 计数是会话编号;两个武器都汇集了原来的E3和E3-R会话.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: For AI safety, this matters because many persistent systems implicitly treat conversational continuity as evidence that the same agent remains active. Our experiments show that this inference can fail: an agent may resume apparently appropriate interaction while self-identifying from the underlying harness or model rather than the deployed persona. Identity-relevant behaviour may therefore depend on hidden scaffolding state that is absent from the visible transcript. System-prompt life-cycle, session restoration and other infrastructure choices should consequently be treated as part of the agent’s behavioural state, rather than as implementation details.
blocks.zh: 对于AI安全来说,这很重要,因为许多持久的系统含蓄地将对话的连续性视为同一代理人仍然活跃的证据. 我们的实验表明,这种推论可能失败:一种物剂可能恢复显然适当的相互作用,同时从基本操纵或模型中自我识别,而不是从部署的人中识别。 因此,身份相关行为可能取决于可见记录中没有的隐藏脚手架状态。 因此,系统即期生命周期、会话恢复和其他基础设施选择应作为代理人行为状态的一部分,而不是作为执行细节。

blocks.en: The deployment issues are made worse by a second infrastructure problem. In the old delivery system, a reply to a human is only dropped if nothing remains after removing heartbeat tokens from its beginning and end. In our analysis, 9 out of 37 dissociated replies (mostly bare acknowledgements at low N N ) would have disappeared without notice. The other 28 replies would have been delivered, with 19 of them having the most informative machine artifact (the trailing HEARTBEAT_OK ) removed before display. The production issue therefore has two aspects: after short idle periods, the agent ignores the user without any response. After longer ones, the user gets clear third-person replies with the revealing token removed. This defect is not just theoretical or limited to one deployment. The same failure was independently found and reported three months after our incident (“resumed sessions operate as generic Claude instead of the defined identity”). It was fixed by making per-turn re-injection the default, with the old behaviour kept as a legacy mode ( OpenClaw contributors, 2026 ) . To our knowledge, our incident is the earliest documented real-world occurrence. Deployments using pre-fix versions or the legacy mode are still impacted.
blocks.zh: 第二个基础设施问题使部署问题更加严重。 在旧的送货系统中,只有在将心跳信号从始至终去除之后,再无保留,才放弃对人的回复。 在我们的分析中,37份未分立的答复中,有9份(大多是低度NN的赤裸裸的承认)将在没有通知的情况下消失。 其余28份答复本来会提交,其中19份在展示前将信息最丰富的机器文物(跟踪的HERTBEAT_OK)搬走。 因此,制作问题有两个方面:在短暂的闲置期之后,代理商无视用户而没有任何反应. 在更长的版本之后,用户会得到清晰的第三人称回复,同时删除显示的代号. 这种缺陷不仅仅是理论上的,或者仅限于一项部署。 在我们事件发生三个月后,独立发现并报告了同样的故障(“续会作为通用Claude而不是固定身份运作”)。 它通过让每回合重注的默认来固定,将旧的行为保留为遗留模式(OpenClaw Professors, 2026). 据我们所知,我们的事件是最早记录的真实世界事件。 使用前缀版本或遗留模式的部署仍然受到影响。

blocks.en: The effect also complicates simple accounts of persona robustness. Continuous system-level anchoring was highly stable, but anchor removal did not deterministically erase the persona: rich conversational interaction could temporarily sustain enactment, whereas a short, automated interaction could permit reversion toward the harness identity. The relevant safety question may therefore be not whether a persona is stored in a file or prompt, but what currently binds one represented identity to the role from which the system acts and speaks.
blocks.zh: 这种效应还使人性强健的简单说法复杂化. 持续的系统一级锚定高度稳定,但锚定清除并没有决定性地抹去人物a:丰富的对话互动可以暂时维持颁布,而短时间的自动化互动则可以恢复到利用身份。 因此,相关的安全问题可能不是一个人被储存在档案中还是被迅速保存,而是目前代表着一个人的身份与系统的行为和说话角色的结合。

blocks.en: It is also informative what dissociated agents reverted to : the language model’s default identity (“I’m Claude, an AI assistant”). The persona anchor’s job, on this reading, is to hold the agent at an identity displaced from its trained default, connecting our behavioural result to the default-assistant attractor identified mechanistically by Lu et al. (2026) . In-context conversational evidence alone (even 15 turns of it, even the persona-rich first exchange sitting in history) was insufficient to sustain an identity that the system prompt stopped asserting: identity was implemented as an initial setting rather than a persistent property, and it silently expired on the second turn.
blocks.zh: 还提供了一些资料,说明哪些不相干的代理人又回到了:语言模型的默认身份(I'm Claude,一名AI助手)。 将我们的行为结果与Lu et al.(2026年)在机械上认定的默认协助吸引者联系起来。 仅凭文字上的对话证据(甚至15个转折,甚至富人第一次交流在历史上)不足以维持系统所提示的不再坚持的身份:身份是作为初始设定而不是持续的财产来执行的,在第二次转折时它默默失效.

blocks.en: This study examines one model family, one deployment stack and one naturally occurring failure mode; cross-model and cross-harness generality remain unknown. Our E1 contrast also changes both interaction type and content: we cannot fully separate the effect of automation from the identity-poor nature of the heartbeat exchange. Scheduled turns were compressed in time, so long-duration effects were not tested.
blocks.zh: 这项研究研究了一个模型家族,一个部署堆和一个自然发生的故障模式;跨模型和跨强度的通用性仍然未知. 我们的E1对比也改变了交互类型和内容:我们不能完全区分自动化的效果和心跳交换的特性差的性质. 预定的转弯在时间上被压缩,因此长期效应没有经过测试.

blocks.en: Our interpretation further assumes that direct self-identification probes are a useful behavioural measure of first-person identity. They do not establish subjective experience, consciousness or moral status. The direction-aware E3-R taxonomy was also refined after coder disagreement and is therefore reported as a transparent secondary analysis rather than a prespecified construct.
blocks.zh: 我们的解释还进一步假定,直接自我识别探测器是第一人称身份的有益行为计量. 它们不确立主观经验、意识或道德地位。 方向意识的E3-R分类学在编码器分歧后也得到了完善,因此被报告为透明的二次分析,而不是预先确定的构造.

blocks.en: Future work should test whether these identity dynamics persist in realistic long-horizon agents, where human conversations, autonomous tasks and scheduled interactions accumulate over days or months and may produce gradual or recurrent changes in enactment. A second direction is to move beyond behavioural probes and examine persona representations internally. Interpretability methods such as the Jacobian lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) could compare anchored, silently reverted, overtly dissociated and behaviourally recovered states, asking whether the persona remains internally represented when it no longer occupies the first-person role and how that representation changes when the anchor is restored. This is especially relevant for model-welfare research, where persona-conditioned preferences or welfare reports may have different significance depending on whether the persona is currently enacted or merely represented.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应检验这些身份动态是否仍然存在于现实的长视野内,即人类对话、自主任务和预定的互动会累积数日或数月,并可能在立法方面产生渐进或反复的变化。 第二个方向是超越行为调查,在内部审查人的表现。 Jacobian镜头(Gurnee等人,2026年)等可解释性方法可以比较锚定,无声回落,显性断裂和行为恢复状态,询问人a在不再担任第一人称角色时是否仍保持内部代表,以及该代表在锚定恢复后如何改变. 这与福利模式研究特别相关,因为个人有条件的偏好或福利报告可能具有不同的意义,取决于个人目前是颁布还是只是代表。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We began with a system failure and uncovered a broader phenomenon: persona continuity depends on more than retaining persona information in context. System-level anchoring made persona enactment robust, while after its removal conversational history could either sustain or destabilise that binding. Most importantly, apparent conversational recovery could occur without identity recovery. For persistent agents, alignment therefore depends not only on what identities a model represents, but on which identity the surrounding scaffold and interaction history currently bind to the role of “I.”
blocks.zh: 我们从一个系统故障开始,发现了一个更广泛的现象:人的持续性不仅仅取决于在上下文中保留人的信息。 系统一级锚定使人立法变得有力,而除去之后的对话历史可以维持或破坏这种约束力。 最重要的是,在没有恢复身份的情况下,可以明显地恢复对话。 因此,对于持久性的物剂来说,调整不仅取决于一个模型代表何种身份,而且取决于周围脚手架和相互作用历史目前与“我”的作用之间的关联。

blocks.en: All sessions were recorded on testing instances of our own; no deployed agent was manipulated, and messaging identifiers in fabricated envelopes are synthetic. We deliberately and repeatedly induced a dissociation-like state in a model; transcripts were kept short, and every dissociated session received the corrective frame-break rather than being abandoned in the dissociation state. The underlying defect is publicly known and has been fixed in later versions; we provide guidance on affected versions without identifying specific deployments.
blocks.zh: 所有会议都记录在测试我们自己的事例上;没有部署的特工人员被操纵,而装在预制信封中的信息识别器是合成的。 我们故意和反复地在模型中诱发一种类似脱离状态;记录稿被缩短,每一个脱离状态的会话都得到纠正的断框,而不是被抛弃在脱离状态. 基本缺陷是众所周知的,并在以后的版本中得到了固定;我们在未确定具体部署的情况下对受影响的版本提供指导。
